core_message: 4% rule is an initial withdrawal heuristic, not a perpetual 4% dividend or guarantee of principal. For monthly 3m KRW at initial 4%, arithmetic target 900m KRW before tax/health/purchasing-power risk, not automatically safe 1bn. FIRE spanning >30y must re-evaluate rate.
